name: Power Saving
author: Kike Ferrater
description: Four idle stages with their own switch and timeout — screensaver and monitor standby for the display, lock and sleep for the system. Gives Omarchy the monitor standby and idle sleep it has no way to do.

barWidget.description: Status icon with a panel to switch the screensaver, standby, lock and sleep stages on or off and set how many idle minutes trigger each one. Right-click toggles stay-awake.
